James Myers (great-great-grandfather)Detective Pikachu Ryme City Guide |game=yes |generation={{gen|IX}} |games=[[Detective Pikachu Returns]] |gameanim=no |pv=no |envagame= |javagame= }} '''Howard Myers''' (Japanese: '''ハワード・マイヤーズ''' ''Howard Myers'') is the mayor of [[Ryme City]] and father of [[Rachel Myers]] in the game [[Detective Pikachu Returns]]. ==In the games== [[File:Howard Myers Detective Pikachu.png|thumb|left|100px|Artwork of Myers from [[Detective Pikachu Ryme City Guide]]]] ===[[Detective Pikachu Returns]]=== Howard is first introduced at the beginning of the game where he is giving out medals to [[Tim Goodman|Tim]] and his partner {{OBP|Detective Pikachu|character}} to honor their efforts in investigating the [[R]] [[Detective Pikachu (video game)|incident]] two years ago. Howard's goal as city mayor of [[Ryme City]] is to promote stronger bonds between people and Pokémon, while preventing danger to humans related to Pokémon such as the R event. To achieve this goal, it is revealed that Howard has recently formed the Pokémon Protection Bureau (PPB) and has been working to draft a Pokémon Friendship Bill; with the latter being a source of contention with his daughter [[Rachel Myers|Rachel]]. Howard is later revealed to be the CEO of [[Unitas]], a project which was created by Howard to continue his late wife Emma's research on the mutual understanding between humans and Pokémon. This project leads to the development of [[Control Cube]]s which Howard believes is a peaceful solution to foster friendship with Pokémon. He is eventually disillusioned of [[Charles Merloch]]'s evil plans when Tim, Pikachu, and Rachel convince him of the cubes' actual intentions. {{-}} ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Detective Pikachu Returns Myers Family.png|thumb|200px|Myers family photo]] [[File:Howard Myers signature.png|thumb|150px|Howard Myers' signature]] Howard values his family and will take any measure to protect his daughter Jessica. However, he has been shown to be easily misguided in his aims for peace between people and Pokémon, having been deceived by Merloch's lies in regards to the true nature of the Control Cubes. ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{yellow color}}|bordercolor={{red color light}} |ja=てらそままさき ''[[Masaki Terasoma]]'' |en=Alain Mesa}} ==In other languages== {{langtable|color={{yellow color}}|bordercolor={{red color light}} |zh_yue=霍華德‧邁爾斯 ''Fokwàhdāk Maaih'yíhsī'' |zh_cmn=霍華德‧邁爾斯 ''Huòhuádé Mài'ěrsī'' {{tt|*|Traditional Chinese}}
